_schema.note: Curated app manifest. scripts/build.mjs compiles each app to public/apps/<id>/<artifact>; scripts/generate.mjs emits one loader page per entry. Adding an app = source (or submodule) + an entry here + rebuild.

fields.id: url-safe slug; also the public/apps/<id>/ directory
fields.name: display label on the gallery card
fields.source: 'local' (compile sourceDir with our javac) | 'submodule' (run build cmd) | 'prebuilt' (copy an existing jar)
fields.sourceDir: for source=local: dir of .java files to compile (relative to repo root)
fields.mainClass: Main-Class written into the jar manifest (source=local)
fields.javaTarget: javac --release level; build fails if > 17 (CheerpJ ceiling)
fields.cheerpjVersion: 8 | 11 | 17 — the runtime the loader inits for this app
fields.display: { w, h } CheerpJ display size in px
fields.thumbnail: image filename (relative to the app dir) copied to public/apps/<id>/
fields.webNotes: porting caveats (see each app's WEB_NOTES.md; do not revert)

apps.name: Bounce
apps.description: An interactive Swing animation - add bouncing shapes and watch them go.
apps.webNotes: Demo app shipped with JavaLab to exercise the gallery; replace with curated submodules.
